## Accessibility Checklist

Before submitting, verify your changes:

- [ ] All interactive elements have `accessibilityLabel` and `accessibilityRole`
- [ ] Touch targets are >= 48dp (56dp recommended)
- [ ] Font sizes meet minimums (body >= 18sp, heading >= 24sp)
- [ ] Color contrast passes WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1)
- [ ] `hitSlop` added to icon/small buttons
- [ ] Ran `node scripts/check-a11y.js` with no new errors

## Testing

- [ ] Documentation is updated (if applicable)
